rows.name: Nature of crime: violence

rows.name: Serious incident notifications: 2025 to 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Notifications involving child death or serious harm are highly sensitive aggregate safeguarding data; no child-level fields are retained and no parcel attribution is permitted.

rows.name: Operation of police powers under TACT 2000, to December 2025
rows.semantic_limit: Terrorism-related arrests, outcomes and stop-search powers are sensitive national or Great Britain context; operational activity cannot be interpreted as parcel risk.

rows.name: User guide to operation of police powers under the Terrorism Act 2000
rows.semantic_limit: Definitions, data providers, outcomes and coverage rules are methodology gates only; they cannot create a terrorism incident or local safety score.

rows.name: Firearm and shotgun certificates, April 2025 to March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Certificates, applications, refusals, revocations and lost or stolen items are licensing-administration statistics; force-area totals are not direct parcel safety evidence.

rows.name: User guide to statistics on firearm and shotgun certificates
rows.semantic_limit: Legislation, coverage, definitions and quality notes are methodology controls only and cannot create a parcel observation.

rows.name: Children in need: 2024 to 2025
rows.semantic_limit: Referrals, assessments and child-protection-plan aggregates concern vulnerable children; no child-level record is retained and no parcel assignment is allowed.

rows.name: Outcomes for children in need, including children looked after: 2024 to 2025
rows.semantic_limit: Education and social outcomes for children in need are sensitive local-authority aggregates and cannot be converted into neighbourhood or parcel safety.

rows.name: Safeguarding adults, England, 2024 to 2025
rows.publisher: Department of Health and Social Care
rows.semantic_limit: Adult safeguarding concerns and section 42 enquiries are sensitive aggregate service data; correction notes and local-authority quality variation must remain visible.

rows.name: Homicide in England and Wales: year ending March 2025
rows.semantic_limit: Homicide Index analyses support national and aggregate offence QA only; detailed record-level source material is not retained or assigned to parcels.

rows.name: Crime against businesses: 2023 Commercial Victimisation Survey
rows.semantic_limit: Business victimisation, prevention and reporting estimates are a separate commercial-safety component and are not residential parcel evidence.

rows.name: Crime in England and Wales: year ending March 2026 announcement
rows.semantic_limit: Release announcement only; no figures are inferred before publication on 23 July 2026 and no parcel evidence is created.
